claims: In March 2026, Trader Joe's and Ajinomoto Foods expanded a recall to over 9 million pounds of frozen ready-to-eat products.
The recalled products include Chicken Fried Rice, Vegetable Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice, and Chicken Shu Mai.
The recall is due to potential contamination with foreign objects, specifically glass fragments.
Chicken Fried Rice best by dates range from 03/04/2026 through 02/10/2027.
Vegetable Fried Rice best by dates range from 02/28/2026 through 11/19/2026.
Japanese Style Fried Rice best by dates range from 02/28/2026 through 11/14/2026.
Chicken Shu Mai best by dates range from 03/13/2026 through 10/23/2026.
Glass fragments are 1-3 cm long and 2-4 mm wide.
Products were distributed nationwide in 43 states.
Some products were exported to Canada and Mexico.
USDA initially classified this as a Class I recall.
Class I recall means there is a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences.
The recall was sparked by customer complaints.
The recall is believed to have originated from a vegetable source ingredient.
No injuries have been officially reported to date.
